scope: Namibia medical discovery — University of Namibia School of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: UNAM's School of Medicine lists the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery programme and describes the school as providing locally relevant clinical training.

UNAM's 2024 School of Medicine prospectus schedules MBChB clinical rotations in fourth through sixth years, including fifth-year rotations at Onandjokwe and Oshakati and community-based education and service in third year.

UNAM's published School of Medicine admissions regulations require academic standing, essay writing and a successful interview; the MBChB subject requirements include English, mathematics, physical science/chemistry and biology/life sciences.
A Government Gazette schedule records UNAM's Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery as National Qualifications Framework level 8.
Namibia Qualifications Authority's 2023 accreditation list identifies UNAM as one of Namibia's two public national universities.

holdReasons: Current MBChB-specific fee data and a current programme prospectus were not assembled for the required payload fields.
The admissions evidence is from the 2022 prospectus and needs current-cycle confirmation; explicit student-support evidence is also incomplete.
nextAction: Obtain the current UNAM School of Medicine prospectus and MBChB fee/support documents, then complete the field-level review before publishing.
